name: BTV Vier Länder Bank AG
summary: BTV Vier Länder Bank AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate and retail banking products and services in Austria and internationally. It operates through five segments: Corporate Customers, Private Customers, Financial Markets, Leasing, and Tourism Holdings. The company offers various deposits that include accounts and cards; and loan products, such as consumer credit, real estate financing, current account overdraft, securities loans, structured corporate financing, export and working capital financing, investment financing, funding, and leasing. It also provides savings and investment solutions, such as securities investment and brokerage, savings products, asset management,…
